# Implementation Engineer handoff

## Approved scope and baseline

- Issue number and URL, approved revision and Test Engineer handoff reference.
- Task branch, frozen test commit SHA and protected paths or reference to the owner-reviewed list.
- Implementation commit SHAs. Record any approved replacement baseline and its correction evidence.

## Acceptance and verification

- Baseline comparison commands, compared SHAs and results. Record reproduced RED and final frozen-test results.
- Supplementary test paths, names and purpose.
- Results by acceptance criterion, with exact local commands, outcomes and evidence. Identify omitted checks and reasons.

## Pull Request and GitHub Actions

Record the PR URL and latest PR head SHA. List applicable checks, actual status and run link. Identify failed, pending or unexecuted checks separately.

## Owner review and limitations

Record remaining limitations, owner-run scenarios and prerequisites, and decisions needed before merge.
